unverifiable_exemptions: Tenant eligibility: age 62 or older before the conversion recording date, permanent disability, or a 60%+ service-connected disability for an honorably discharged veteran
Income eligibility test: family income no more than three times the county average per-person income or $50,000, whichever is greater
coverage.summary: Applies to eligible senior, disabled and disabled-veteran tenants in buildings being converted to condominium, cooperative or fee-simple ownership of units.
coverage.other_conditions: The tenant must have lived in the building at least one year before the conversion recording date.

result.notes: The coverage values are supported by the DCA Truth in Renting guide (D067). The guide gives no unit-count threshold for the Protected Tenancy Act. The 'two or more dwelling units' language comes from the Anti-Eviction Act conversion ground (2A:18-61.1(k)), not this Act, so min_units stays null. Tenant age, disability and income eligibility cannot be checked from building data, so they are listed as unverifiable. The Hudson County Tenant Protection Act of 1992 is a separate law and is excluded.
